sentence: This project studies molecular life sciences topics, including mycobacterial pathogens, photosynthesis, DNA and protein engineering, and epigenetic mechanisms involving small non-coding RNA.
This project studies Streptocarpus plants to find out how plant regeneration and meristem formation are controlled.
This project builds a tool that turns small single cells into large, bright fluorescent spots so a microscope can see them.
This project uses mass spectrometry to study how a membrane transporter is regulated when cells face oxidative insult.
This project builds a framework that combines artificial intelligence with mathematical proof to design computer chips that behave correctly.
This project studies how limits on quantum memory restrict the speed-ups that quantum computers can give over classical computers.
This project builds a regional network that aims to speed up ways to prevent, diagnose, and treat muscle, bone, and joint injury and disease.
This project studies how to run artificial intelligence on small edge devices with limited resources so it stays accurate, efficient, and robust.
This project uses speckle imaging to look for companion stars around K dwarf and M dwarf stars near the Sun.
This project uses nuclear-magnetic-resonance signals and computer simulations to measure pore size, viscosity, and surface adhesion in porous materials.
This project studies how robots can understand verbal messages and nonverbal cues from people and adjust when people's behavior changes.
This project develops methods and theory for solving inverse problems in which the collected data relate nonlinearly to the unknowns being sought.
This project builds a searchable database of hydrologic process knowledge to find global patterns in how water moves through the landscape.
This project builds mathematical tools that work out hidden causes from indirect or noisy observations, using optimal transport and probability measures.
This project builds hardware and software designs that keep self-driving cars safe and let them improve over time, even during rare events.
This project builds machine learning models that include physical laws to predict how chemical reactions, biocatalysts, and polymers behave.
This project studies how to protect cloud computing services that use field-programmable gate-arrays from malicious attacks.
This project studies unconventional magnetic domains in few-layer 2D van der Waals magnets and how their magnetic states switch.
